reviews.title: Joke Of An App
reviews.text: I couldn’t remember why I had removed this app from my phone and promptly realized it was because there was no longer a free version. They gatekeep your photos so you can make a collage but cannot save without signing up and paying a subscription fee. When I tried to just screenshot albeit not the best option it literally interferes with your ability to screenshot which doesn’t even seem possible for them to have CONTROL OVER YOUR PHONE??? Enough to completely erase the photo from a screenshot??? Very uncool. I deleted the app but I’m sure they still have my information and no way for me to get it deleted from their system. I’m sure this sounds like your average “disgruntled” customer who didn’t get their way, but don’t bother. If you’re going to charge to use the app don’t let it even download for free. A JOKE!
